sample_points_from_meshes_basic: sample points uniformly from a batch of PyTorch3D meshes by face area
sample_points_from_meshes_with_normals: sample points from meshes and return surface normals for each sampled point
sample_points_from_meshes_with_textures: sample points from textured meshes and return texture values for each sampled point
sample_points_from_meshes_full: sample points from meshes returning coordinates, normals, and textures in a single call
rand_barycentric_coords: generate random barycentric coordinates uniformly distributed over a triangle for mesh sampling
